title: Hold a licence to handle explosives
what: Handle explosives or explosive precursors (manufacture, store, sell, transport or use them) only under a licence where the Act or regulations require one.

sources.title: Explosives Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not handle an explosive or explosive precursor if— (a) this Act or the regulations require the handling to be authorised by a licence under this Act, and (b) the person is not authorised to do so by a licence under this Act

sources.title: Explosives Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: SafeWork NSW (as referred to in clause 1 of Schedule 2 to the Work Health and Safety Act 2011) is the regulatory authority for the purposes of this Act, except as provided by this section.

reach.condition: if it handles explosives or explosive precursors (such as for blasting, manufacture, storage or sale)
